row1.rule: any input uses data after its decision time

tau_rounding.finding: every stored tau_ns in b1 t2_tau, b2 and S1 is a multiple of 256 ns: float64-rounded upstream (error <= 128 ns either way)
tau_rounding.handling: decision time at tau = tau_d = max(stored tau, the crossing print's own timestamp); b2 / S1 inputs built on the stored tau are then <= tau_d, the crossing print is <= tau_d, and entries are after it

short_interest_dating: F1 si_asof_ns is the settlement date, not publication (Cooper R2)

tau_spike_guard.note: tau is the first print >= 1.30 x prior close that is not a spike; the spike test reads the print after it, so tau is confirmed at its successor
tau_spike_guard.definition: seconds from the tau print to its successor in the sorted print sequence (the spike guard reads that successor)

decision_time_properties.live_set: live_n / flow_share count other D1 names that crossed at or before tau; D1 membership is the vendor's day-level selection (momentum_pct, RTH high), so the live set is conditional on that selection boundary like the whole population (D4, A13)
decision_time_properties.label: the label (S1 theory type) is hindsight by definition and is only ever an output
